document_title: Order on Georgia Power Company's Revision to Rules and Regulations Tariff Compliance Filing (the >=100 MW large-load regime)
how_obtained: Fetched the GA PSC FACTS document-detail page /search/facts-document/?documentId=222325 to read its download link. The PDF rendition of this order (fileId 103476, '222325.pdf') is a scanned image with no usable text layer, so I downloaded the DOCX rendition the Commission published alongside it, from https://services.psc.ga.gov/api/v1/External/Public/Get/Document/DownloadFile/222325/103475. Converted it by reading word/document.xml out of the DOCX zip with Python zipfile + ElementTree, emitting one line per <w:p> paragraph, mapping <w:tab> to a tab and <w:br>/<w:cr> to a newline. No other cleanup: tabs, blank paragraphs and the Commission letterhead block are exactly as stored in the file.
